{{Conjecture|legends}}
'''[[Sal Olbeg]]'s estate''' was located on the outskirts of [[Rytal Prime]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Dayark]]. A large estate, it also operated as a farm. The marshy grounds were arranged into neat squares separated by dikes and tended to by agricultural [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. The main building was a glass-domed structure raised up out of the water on pilings, and surrounded by a stone wall. The water was filtered and heated, and made an ideal outside swimming pool.
